CustomField.description: Calculated difficulty rating based on company Tier
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Tier__c, "FAANG / Top Product"), "Very Hard", IF(ISPICKVAL(Tier__c, "Product Company"), "Hard", IF(ISPICKVAL(Tier__c, "Startup"), "Medium-Hard", IF(ISPICKVAL(Tier__c, "Services / Consulting"), "Medium", IF(ISPICKVAL(Tier__c, "Mid-Market"), "Medium", IF(ISPICKVAL(Tier__c, "Enterprise"), "Hard", "Not Set"))))))
CustomField.label: Interview Difficulty
